articles.title: One Step Forward, Two Steps Back: CA's AB 1856 Exempts Open Source But Expands Age-Gating
articles.summary: After public outrage, California lawmakers are moving closer to exempting open-source operating systems from the sweeping age-bracketing regime mandated by last year’s Digital Age Assurance Act (AB 1043). Nonetheless, the current bill still jeopardizes internet users’ speech, privacy, and security.
